title: Dogwood Lookout | KEY.co
description_expanded: This newly constructed modern beach retreat combines elevated coastal design with the comforts of a true home-away-from-home. With sweeping Gulf views and a sprawling private pool, the home’s open, sun-drenched layout creates a welcoming space for families and groups to gather and unwind. Five king suites offer luxurious privacy, each adorned with soft textures, calming hues, and curated furnishings for a serene, hotel-like experience. A custom queen-over-queen bunk room adds flexibility and charm, making it as functional as it is stylish. Every inch of the home has been thoughtfully crafted, from the breezy coastal décor to the seamless indoor-outdoor flow that invites relaxation at every turn. Outdoor living is just as refined, with a spacious poolside lounge and a top-level balcony that delivers breathtaking Gulf sunsets. Located minutes from the vibrant communities of Seaside and WaterColor, the home offers easy access to dining, boutique shopping, and local adventures by foot or bike. For those traveling with a larger group, the neighboring property, Wild Blue, can be rented in tandem to accommodate extended families or multi-family vacations. Whether you're seeking laid-back beach days or memorable nights under the stars, this luxurious escape offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and unforgettable moments by the sea.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
